associations.rationale: The total number of irreducible classes is a consequence and consistency check for the classification, not an exhaustive identification of the classes.
This counts the nontrivial p-th-root parameters used by one classified family and is only a supporting enumeration.
The iff directly establishes irredundancy within the family of one-dimensional character representations.
The non-isomorphism directly establishes that the character and rhoHom families do not overlap, a required part of irredundancy.
Restricting irreducible dimensions to 1 or p is a consequence useful in proving exhaustion, but does not identify all irreducibles.
The displayed equivalence targets an opaque IrrepIndex type, so it does not visibly state which representations form the classification.
The iff directly establishes irredundancy of the rhoHom family by identifying isomorphism exactly with equality of parameters.
This directly states exhaustion: every simple representation is isomorphic to either a character representation or a nontrivial rhoHom representation.
The sum-of-squared-dimensions identity is a completeness check used by the classification argument, not the classification itself.
